relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: Gain‐of‐function mutations in VGSC Nav1.7, that promote neuronal hyperexcitability, can cause human pain conditions.

relationships.subject: SCN9A c.554G>A variant
relationships.evidence_quote: which is a gain‐of‐function variant which enhanced resurgent currents within the DRG neurons and renders DRG neurons hyperexcitable

key_findings: 61-year-old patient with the SCN9A c.554G>A VUS showed combined IEM, PEPD and SFN phenotypes (the 'pain triangle').
